title: Shiraishi An — Gotta Be An English Master!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today's lesson was so hard...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm glad that they're increasing the difficulty a little to help us get ready for our trip to the US... But I'm exhausted.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You two do look tired.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you both seemed even more motivated compared to last time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! I think it's because we know we're actually going now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we gotta get to a level where we can at least get by okay over there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It is easier to work hard when you have a clear goal in mind.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Still, writing in English is really hard...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, speaking and writing do pose different challenges.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm just barely managing because Toya's been helping me, but I feel like I'm never gonna get the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, since the spelling for some words is so tricky...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's the thing! You can mime your way through conversations, but you can't do that when you're writing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I guess I don't have time to be complaining right now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We've just gotta keep doing our best to make sure that we do fine when we go over to the US...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, An...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You don't have to if you don't want to, but...
A few days later
An's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Pardon me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Welcome!
Sorry for having you come over like this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, that's okay. After all, this was my suggestion.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So, anyway...
Can you show me what you've written, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Here you are, Ms. Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Ms. Kohane...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I asked my teacher yesterday about how to improve our English writing skills. I was told that it's best not to plan what you write in Japanese too much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't plan it in Japanese?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because word order differs greatly between Japanese and English.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why things can turn out really funny when you try to translate Japanese text word for word.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “If I could speak English better, then I'd be able to become friends with more people.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I feel like we covered this sentence structure during one of our lessons.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, then... What if I turned this into a grammar quiz?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that'd be really helpful! If you don't mind!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I feel like I'm really starting to get the hang of this thanks to Kohane.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Alright, last problem...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Done...!
Can you check to see how I did, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: S-Sorry, I didn't mean to doze off...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, she mentioned something about practicing speaking English more in preparation for our trip...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (She's so busy that she's losing sleep, but she's taking the time to help me like this.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If you're sleepy, Kohane, do you wanna lie down for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: N-No, I'm okay.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I can't sleep knowing that you're still hard at work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd say that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
But let's take a quick break.
I'm getting kinda hungry from all the concentrating!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I suppose.
It has already been three hours.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Then, let's take a break!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I actually bought some cookies just for today. Also, I'll go grab us some refills.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? Then, let's go.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: After we've recharged our batteries with some sweets, I'll get right back to work, Ms. Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Please stop calling me that...!
